title: Bluetooth mice and keyboards keep working, with new keys to take control back
highlights: Pick up a Bluetooth mouse or keyboard again within a second after it sleeps and reconnects.
Left Shift+Escape or Escape three times brings the mouse and keyboard back while controlling another computer.
Ctrl+Shift+Escape remains the emergency stop when no other computer is being controlled.
Escape keys also work through the X11 grab when capture has lost the keyboard.
Release the local mouse automatically when a click or key press is not being captured.
